description:
Fetch the full competitor analysis report as structured JSON.

    Reports contain: website snapshot, Wayback Machine history, SEO/traffic
    data (DataForSEO), social media presence, Product Hunt launches, GitHub
    stats, pricing, funding, AI-generated business insights, growth
    playbooks, and more.

    Args:
        job_id: ID from analyze_competitor(); status must be 'completed'

    Returns:
        The full report dict (nested structure), or {error} if not found / not ready.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: get_report
